buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of DCA, MRAU payable at CHENNAI . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The supplier should upload all the necessary documents as mentioned in the uploaded ATC document a nd should comply with all the terms and conditions mentioned therein failing which offers will be liable for rejection. 2. For future correspondence please mention our file Ref no: DPS/MRPU/9/5/24427 along with GeM Bid n umber. 3. Successful bidder has to furnish PSDBG within 15 days of release of Contract, failing which an incident w ill be raised against the seller for failing to furnish PSDBG as per NIT T&C. 4. Also, material supplied (If any) against the contract will not be allowed within the purchaser's premises till submission & acceptance of the PSDBG by the seller.

5. The supplier/bidder should be an OEM/OEM authorized dealer of TOSHIBA MAK E, with valid OEM Authorization Certificate duly signed & stamped for the tender ed item, failing which their offer shall be rejected NOTE: a) Bidder shall furnish their compliance to the technical specification as per bid parameters with absolute values offered by them in their letterhead duly stampe d & signed, failing which offer will be rejected. . 7.
